info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v4-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Limits API provides access to the defined limits for processing credit card applications. It allows users to retrieve the current thresholds imposed on the number of applications that can be submitted, ensuring compliance with financial regulations. This API is particularly useful for banking institutions and financial service providers that need to manage application flows effectively. By leveraging this endpoint, consumers can optimize their application handling strategies based on the limits fetched.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the limit settings for applications, providing essential information about the maximum allowed configurations and constraints for application usage.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving application limit data. This body structure specifies the necessary parameters that the API expects to process the request successfully.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

state.description: Current state of the application limit.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.
